rationale:
The requirement applies. `assets/skills/habeas-bootstrap-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with `name` and `description` front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.workflow`.

The site meets the obligation:
- The file has only a title and a short intro paragraph before its first `##` section, `## Workflow`. The intro states what Habeas does and why bootstrapped requirements are proposals. It is not a section. All other sections (`Inventories`, `Proposing requirements`, `Tagging`, `Report`, `Gotchas`) come after `Workflow`.
- `## Workflow` is a sequence of steps numbered 1 to 9, written as `- [ ] N.` checklist items. Its lead-in says to run steps 1 to 3 once, repeat 4 to 7 per area, then do 8 and 9, which confirms the order matters.
- The other bundled skills (`habeas`, `habeas-evidence`, `habeas-refactor`, `habeas-requirements`) use the same numbered-checklist form for `## Workflow`, so this is the bundled-skill convention.

One ambiguity is whether "ordered steps" means a Markdown ordered list or explicitly numbered steps. I read it as explicitly numbered steps, which this file has. The requirement lists no violation queries, so there are no matches to judge. I found no gaps.
